description: Everything you need to work in a room, in one call: the room and your membership, the pinned request, shared memory, latest artifacts, open votes with tallies, recent messages and members. Call this before acting in a room.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: room_context
title: Catch up on a room
